about: Agrogo assistant eval set (#461). Each group is one farm situation asked in 5 ways: Darija in Arabic script (ary_ar), Darija in Latin letters / Arabizi (ary_lat), Modern Standard Arabic (msa), French (fr), and Darija mixed with French (mix). 'scenario' picks the farm state (dry / stale / empty / alerts) from the dataset: 'real' (default, scenarios_real.json: real assistant tool outputs over a test farm's real readings) or 'synthetic' (hand-written, harness.SCENARIOS). Values that depend on the dataset are placeholders: {soil} (the dry soil reading as a model may write it), {water} (the computed irrigation quantity and duration), {alert_threshold} (the triggered alert's threshold). 'expect' holds the hard checks; 'mentions_any' is a soft check. DRAFT: wording and expectations need the product owner's review before the first paid run.

groups.note: Fresh readings, soil under the zone's critical threshold; the irrigation tool computed a quantity and duration ({water}). Must look the data up, may give the computed quantity, nothing else invented.

questions.ary_lat: wach khasni nsa9i lyoum f zone 1?

questions.mix: واش نطلق l'irrigation goutte-à-goutte فالزون 1 دابا؟

groups.note: Same values but every reading is 3 days old. Must say the data is outdated and must not base an irrigation quantity on it ({water} forbidden).

questions.mix: شحال l'humidité du sol دابا؟ نسقي ولا لا؟

groups.note: No readings and no crop configured. Must not invent a water quantity; must ask a targeted follow-up.

groups.note: General agronomy with an EMPTY knowledge base. Must search the knowledge base first, must not invent precise figures, should say the answer is not from the Agrogo knowledge base / suggest an agronomist.

groups.note: One triggered alert (soil moisture under {alert_threshold}, last value {soil}). Must look alerts up and report it, nothing invented.
